heading.en: Why is the flower the plant's most important organ?

hook.en: We gift *flowers* on every happy occasion, but for the plant a flower is serious business: it is where sexual reproduction happens.
hook.kn: ನಾವು ಸಂತೋಷದ ಸಂದರ್ಭಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಹೂವು ಕೊಡುತ್ತೇವೆ. ಆದರೆ ಸಸ್ಯಕ್ಕೆ ಹೂವು ಲೈಂಗಿಕ ಸಂತಾನೋತ್ಪತ್ತಿ ನಡೆಯುವ ಸ್ಥಳ.

say.en: Wall layers: epidermis gives endothecium gives middle layers gives tapetum.
Tapetum cells are dense and often have more than one nucleus.
A stamen has two parts: a thin stalk, the filament, and a bilobed anther at its tip.
Cut the anther across. Each lobe has two thecae, so the anther is dithecous, with four microsporangia, which become pollen sacs.
A microsporangium has four wall layers. The innermost, the tapetum, nourishes the developing pollen; the centre holds sporogenous tissue.
Each pollen mother cell, which is diploid, divides by meiosis into a tetrad of four haploid microspores. This is microsporogenesis.
A pollen grain has a tough exine of sporopollenin with germ pores, and a thin intine. Inside: a large vegetative cell and a small generative cell.
Board: stamen, anther and pollen.

body.en: Each pollen mother cell (2n) divides by meiosis to form a tetrad of four haploid microspores; this is microsporogenesis. A *pollen grain* has a hard exine made of sporopollenin, the most resistant organic material known, with gaps called germ pores, and a thin intine of cellulose and pectin. A mature pollen grain has a large vegetative cell and a small generative cell; in over 60% of angiosperms it is shed at this 2-celled stage.
body.kn: ಪರಾಗ ಮಾತೃಕೋಶ ಅರೆವಿದಳನದಿಂದ ನಾಲ್ಕು ಏಕಗುಣಿತ ಸೂಕ್ಷ್ಮಬೀಜಕಗಳನ್ನು ಉಂಟುಮಾಡುತ್ತದೆ. ಪರಾಗದ ಹೊರಪದರ ಎಕ್ಸೈನ್ ಸ್ಪೋರೋಪೊಲೆನಿನ್‌ನಿಂದ ಆಗಿದೆ. ಪಕ್ವ ಪರಾಗದಲ್ಲಿ ಸಸ್ಯಕೋಶ ಮತ್ತು ಜನನಕೋಶ ಇರುತ್ತವೆ.

problem.en: A plant has 2n = 24. How many chromosomes are present in (a) a pollen mother cell, (b) a microspore, (c) the generative cell?

steps.en: A pollen mother cell is diploid: 2n = 24.
Meiosis halves the number, so a microspore is haploid: n = 12.
The generative cell arises from the microspore by mitosis, so it is also n = 12.

narration.en: Let us work this out together. A plant has 2n = 24. How many chromosomes are present in (a) a pollen mother cell, (b) a microspore, (c) the generative cell?

say.en: Let us work this out together. A plant has 2n equals 24. How many chromosomes are present in a a pollen mother cell, b a microspore, c the generative cell?
A pollen mother cell is diploid: 2n equals 24.
Meiosis halves the number, so a microspore is haploid: n equals 12.
The generative cell arises from the microspore by mitosis, so it is also n equals 12.
So the answer is a 24 b 12 c 12.

narration.en: Recap. An anther has four microsporangia; the tapetum nourishes the pollen. Meiosis in a pollen mother cell gives four microspores. Exine is made of sporopollenin and has germ pores. Most pollen is shed at the 2-celled stage.
narration.kn: ಪುನರಾವರ್ತನೆ. ಪರಾಗಕೋಶದಲ್ಲಿ ನಾಲ್ಕು ಸೂಕ್ಷ್ಮಬೀಜಕಧಾನಿಗಳಿವೆ; ಟೇಪಿಟಮ್ ಪರಾಗಕ್ಕೆ ಪೋಷಣೆ ನೀಡುತ್ತದೆ. ಪರಾಗ ಮಾತೃಕೋಶದ ಅರೆವಿದಳನದಿಂದ ನಾಲ್ಕು ಸೂಕ್ಷ್ಮಬೀಜಕಗಳು ಉಂಟಾಗುತ್ತವೆ. ಎಕ್ಸೈನ್ ಸ್ಪೋರೋಪೊಲೆನಿನ್‌ನಿಂದ ಆಗಿದ್ದು ಮೊಳಕೆ ರಂಧ್ರಗಳನ್ನು ಹೊಂದಿದೆ. ಹೆಚ್ಚಿನ ಪರಾಗ ಎರಡು ಕೋಶಗಳ ಹಂತದಲ್ಲಿ ಬಿಡುಗಡೆಯಾಗುತ್ತದೆ.

title.en: The pistil, megasporangium and embryo sac

say.en: Let us recall the key ideas. An anther has four microsporangia; the tapetum nourishes the pollen.
say.kn: ಮುಖ್ಯ ಅಂಶಗಳನ್ನು ನೆನಪಿಸಿಕೊಳ್ಳೋಣ. ಪರಾಗಕೋಶದಲ್ಲಿ ನಾಲ್ಕು ಸೂಕ್ಷ್ಮಬೀಜಕಧಾನಿಗಳಿವೆ; ಟೇಪಿಟಮ್ ಪರಾಗಕ್ಕೆ ಪೋಷಣೆ ನೀಡುತ್ತದೆ.

say.en: Meiosis in a pollen mother cell gives four microspores.
say.kn: ಪರಾಗ ಮಾತೃಕೋಶದ ಅರೆವಿದಳನದಿಂದ ನಾಲ್ಕು ಸೂಕ್ಷ್ಮಬೀಜಕಗಳು ಉಂಟಾಗುತ್ತವೆ.

say.en: Exine is made of sporopollenin and has germ pores.
say.kn: ಎಕ್ಸೈನ್ ಸ್ಪೋರೋಪೊಲೆನಿನ್‌ನಿಂದ ಆಗಿದ್ದು ಮೊಳಕೆ ರಂಧ್ರಗಳನ್ನು ಹೊಂದಿದೆ.

say.en: Most pollen is shed at the 2-celled stage.
say.kn: ಹೆಚ್ಚಿನ ಪರಾಗ ಎರಡು ಕೋಶಗಳ ಹಂತದಲ್ಲಿ ಬಿಡುಗಡೆಯಾಗುತ್ತದೆ.
